## Personal Profile

Jake Thornton is a Certified Nurse-Midwife and founder of Jake's Table, a home-based Southern-fusion cooking class out of his East Lake kitchen in Atlanta. He grew up in Baltimore, Maryland and moved to Atlanta for nursing school; his mother Linda later relocated to Savannah after retirement. American by birth and by raising, with roots in Maryland on his mother's side and a deep food culture pulled from both his Thornton family and his husband Marcus's Johnson family in southwest Atlanta.
